test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

She said to her mother, “May I have another slice of cake?”

options.text: She asked her mother that may I have another slice of cake.
She asked her mother if she might have another slice of cake.
She asked her mother if she may have another slice of cake.
She asked her mother that may she have another slice of cake.

solution:
The correct answer is **She asked her mother if she might have another slice of cake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas and inverted commas are removed.
 
• The reporting verb ''asked'' remains as it is, the question mark (?) becomes the full stop (.).
 
• To change a **direct question to an indirect question**, you just **add 'if'** and change the word order back to a **normal positive sentence**.
 
• The first-person pronoun ''I'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''**s**he''.
 
• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (May) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (might) + Object'.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• You may think the reporting verb 'that' should be used but the question mark or interrogative sentence indicates the use of 'if'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Present simple (Subject +V1st + Object)
 Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Present perfect (Subject + has/have+V3+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past simple (Subject+V2+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1+ing+ Object)
 Past perfect continuous (Subject+had been+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Future simple (Subject+ will/shall+V1+object)
 Present Conditional (Subject+would+V1+object)
 
 

 Future Continuous (Subject +will/shall+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Conditional Continuous (Subject +would+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
